blocks.text: Inductor (jise coil ya choke bhi kehte hain) do terminals (sire) wala passive component (hissa) hai. Is ki self-inductance bohat zyada aur resistance na hone ke barabar hoti hai. Jab is mein current guzarta hai to yeh energy magnetic field mein jama karta hai. Current ke achanak surges ya spikes (uchhal) ko yeh dheema karta hai: energy thori der jama karta hai aur phir circuit ko wapas de deta hai.
Farz karein inductance L wala inductor (resistance na hone ke barabar) frequency f wale AC source se jura hai (Fig. 17.7(a)), aur current yeh hai:
Coil ki inductance L ho to badalta current coil mein back emf (ulti emf) paida karta hai, jis ki magnitude (miqdar):
Current chalta rakhne ke liye lagaya gaya voltage is back emf ke barabar hona chahiye. Is liye coil par voltage:

blocks.text: ΔI/Δt waqt ke saath current badalne ka rate (raftar) hai. Yahi I-t graph ka slope (dhalwan) bhi hai.

blocks.text_alt: As   I = Iₒ sin ωt, so

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Δ/Δt ka matlab hai 'waqt ke saath kitni tezi se badal raha hai'. sin ωt ke change (tabdeeli) ka rate ω cos ωt hota hai. Akhir mein cos ko sin (ωt + π/2) likh kar pata chalta hai ke voltage current se π/2 aage hai.

Eq. 17.15 se pata chalta hai ke inductor L par voltage current se aage (leading) hai; doosre lafzon mein inductor wale AC circuit mein current voltage se peeche (lagging) hai (Figs. 17.7(b) aur 17.7(c)). Inductor mein current hamesha voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) peeche rehta hai. Inductor jo opposition (rukawat) dalta hai use inductive reactance X_L kehte hain:

blocks.alt: (a) AC source V ke saath loop mein inductor L; current I = Io sin wt. (c) VL reference line par aur IL us se 90 degree peeche, dono w par anticlockwise ghoomte.

blocks.text: Yahan Vᵣₘₛ inductor par alternating voltage ki rms qeemat aur Iᵣₘₛ us mein guzarne wala rms current hai.

blocks.text_alt: As Vᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Vₒ and Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ, so
As Vₒ = ωLIₒ, so X_L = ωLIₒ/Iₒ

blocks.text: Yani X_L frequency aur inductance L dono ke directly proportional (seedha mutabiq) hai: f ya L dugna to X_L dugna. DC mein f = 0 hai, is liye X_L = 0; zyada frequency wale AC mein X_L bhi bara hota hai. Natija: inductor DC ko guzarne deta hai lekin AC ko rokta hai. X_L ki unit ohm hai.
